whyClean.title: The smell isn't the bin's fault
whyClean.desc: Trash residue bakes into the plastic all summer. A garden hose can't fix that — hot water and a scrub can.

whyClean.title: Fewer flies, fewer surprises
whyClean.desc: A dirty bin is an open invitation for flies, ants and the occasional midnight raccoon inspection. A clean bin is just a bin.

whyClean.title: Your driveway stays clean too
whyClean.desc: Everything we wash off goes into the truck's reclaim tank and gets disposed of properly — nothing runs down your driveway or into the storm drain.

owner.name: Tessa Larkin
owner.heading: Why we started Sage & Suds
owner.bio: Tessa Larkin got tired of holding her breath every Tuesday. One July afternoon, after fishing a bag of week-old mystery out of the bottom of her can, she borrowed a pressure washer, cleaned every bin on her street, and realized nobody actually enjoys living with a dirty trash can — they just assume nothing can be done about it. Sage & Suds is the something: a truck, a hot-water wash, and a route that follows the garbage truck so your bin is clean an hour after it's empty.

faq.q: Do I need to be home?
faq.a: Nope. Leave your bins at the curb after pickup and we'll take it from there. Most customers only know we came because the bin smells like nothing.

faq.q: What happens to the dirty water?
faq.a: It leaves with us. The wash happens over a containment system on the truck, and the water goes into a reclaim tank for proper disposal — not down your driveway or into the storm drain.

faq.q: My bin is… really bad. Can you fix it?
faq.a: Almost always, yes. The first visit on any plan is a deep clean, and the One-Time Rescue exists for exactly this bin. If a bin is genuinely beyond saving, we'll say so instead of charging you to polish it.
Trash, recycling and compost carts — any standard roll-out bin. Mix and match on any plan; the per-bin price is the same.

faq.q: How do I know which day you come?
faq.a: Check the route map above — we follow the city's collection schedule, so your wash day is built around your trash day. Holiday weeks slide one day, exactly like your pickup does.
No. Plans are month-to-month, and a text message is enough to pause, skip a visit or cancel. We'd rather earn the next visit than lock you into it.
